content.json:
# 🔐 Zero Trust Dashboard
Identity-centric Zero Trust posture: MFA adoption, Conditional Access effectiveness, risky users, privileged access, device compliance, and guest accounts.

content.query:
AADUserRegistrationDetails
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsMfaRegistered) by UserPrincipalName
| summarize Registered = countif(IsMfaRegistered == true), Total = count()
| extend MfaAdoptionPercentage = round(100.0 * Registered / Total, 1)
| project MfaAdoptionPercentage

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-expand CA = ConditionalAccessPolicies
| where tostring(CA.result) in ('success','failure','notApplied')
| summarize Success = countif(tostring(CA.result) == 'success'), Total = count()
| extend ConditionalAccessSuccessRate = round(100.0 * Success / Total, 1)
| project ConditionalAccessSuccessRate

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend IsCompliant = tobool(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
| summarize Compliant = countif(IsCompliant == true), NonCompliant = countif(IsCompliant == false or isempty(IsCompliant))
| extend DeviceCompliancePercentage = round(100.0 * Compliant / (Compliant + NonCompliant), 1)
| project Compliant, NonCompliant, DeviceCompliancePercentage

AADRiskyUsers
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserPrincipalName
| where RiskState in ('atRisk','confirmedCompromised')
| project UserPrincipalName, RiskLevel, RiskState, RiskLastUpdatedDateTime
| sort by RiskLevel desc

let PrivilegedRoles = dynamic(['Global Administrator','Privileged Role Administrator','Security Administrator','Exchange Administrator','SharePoint Administrator','User Administrator','Application Administrator','Cloud Application Administrator']);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName in ('Add member to role','Add eligible member to role','Remove member from role')
| extend RoleName = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[1].newValue)
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where RoleName has_any (PrivilegedRoles)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, RoleName, TargetUser
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName in ('Add member to role completed (PIM activation)','Add member to role in PIM completed (permanent)')
| extend ActivatedRole = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[1].newValue), ActivatedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, ActivatedBy, ActivatedRole
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend IsCompliant = tobool(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
| summarize Compliant = countif(IsCompliant == true), NonCompliant = countif(IsCompliant == false or isempty(IsCompliant))
| extend DeviceCompliancePercentage = round(100.0 * Compliant / (Compliant + NonCompliant), 1)
| project Compliant, NonCompliant, DeviceCompliancePercentage

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where UserPrincipalName has '#EXT#'
| summarize SignInCount = count(), LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName
| sort by SignInCount desc
